verdict.rationale: Supabase exposes machine-readable docs (llms.txt), a public OpenAPI spec, auto-generated type-safe client definitions (database.types.ts), and an official MCP server that lets AI assistants interact with Supabase projects — all supporting AI-native SDK usage. Missing for 10: explicit dedicated SDK reference docs per language (e.g., supabase-js/py) formatted for LLM consumption, and independent hands-on validation of SDK quality beyond the MCP security discussion.
